newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up, spot mth firmer on tightness.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up, spot mth firmer on tightness.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Sentiment was firm and prices, particularly May futures closed higher due to tightness. Trading was volatile and traders are optimistic that third mth July futures contract will test 1,300 ringgit next week. But any major gains could be limited by rising output.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also ended firmer, with some refiners covering among nearby CPOs and selected products.
Spot month May futures rose 22 ringgit to 1,334 ringgit. Trading was fairly moderate and turnover was 2,130 lots.

Physicals May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,370 vs bids of 1,365 after trading from 1,360 to 1,370. May (central) saw offers at 1,350 vs bids 1,342.50 with earlier trades done at 1,340 and 1,345.
June (south) was offered at 1,350 vs bids at 1,345 with earlier trades done at 1,345.
June (central) saw offers at 1,315 versus bids at 1,310.
In refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $572.50, June at $565 and July/Aug/Sept at $555.
May RBD palm olein saw offers at $612.50, June at $600 and July/Aug/Sept at $582.50. July was traded at $607.50, June at $597.50, $595 and $590.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $437.50, June at $430 and May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
